clue.text: The way things are with a libertine's love-life

definitions.meaning: a rake's series of romantic liaisons

explanation.surface: Musing on how things stand with a womaniser's romantic entanglements.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means the present situation, and read literally it describes a rake's string of romances.

clue.text: Minute portions as extra helpings

definitions.meaning: further servings of food after the first plate

explanation.surface: Tiny servings offered as a second round at dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: Units of time that divide a minute, and also another plateful taken at a meal.

clue.text: Ebb tide makes very little difference

definitions.meaning: read literally, the sea level falling a little
an insignificant amount set against the whole

explanation.surface: Remark that a falling tide barely changes anything.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a negligible contribution, and taken literally a receding tide is the sea dropping.

clue.text: Love divine

parts.note: the Greek god of desire, love personified as a deity

explanation.definitionFit: The Greek god of desire embodies love as a deity.

clue.text: Toadstool provides amusement to young Augustus

parts.note: amusement means fun
Gus is the familiar short form of the name Augustus

explanation.surface: A child named Augustus is entertained by a toadstool.
explanation.definitionFit: A toadstool is an example of a mushroom-like growth of that kingdom.

clue.text: In favour of a lock as a defence

parts.note: for means in favour of
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: Backing a lock on the door as protection.
explanation.definitionFit: A stronghold is a fortified military defence.

clue.text: Each strict building regulation must concern them

definitions.text: Each strict building regulation must concern them

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are built into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Designers of buildings must heed every strict code.
explanation.walkthrough: 'building' rearranges EACH STRICT, and the whole clue describes the professionals who must follow planning codes.
explanation.definitionFit: Designers of buildings must comply with every construction code.

clue.text: Rebellion about Darwinian theory making fundamental changes

indicators.note: the word for rebellion goes about, that is around, the theory

parts.note: a rising is a rebellion
evolution is the theory set out by Charles Darwin

explanation.surface: An uprising over Darwin's ideas transforms everything.
explanation.definitionFit: To transform something completely is to overturn it radically.

clue.text: Forced to give promotion in the Police Department

indicators.note: the promotion sits in the police abbreviation

parts.note: PD is the abbreviation for Police Department
a rise is a promotion

explanation.surface: Pressured into promoting someone within the force.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts RISE inside PD. 'Forced' as in levered open.
explanation.definitionFit: Levered open, as a lid prised off with a crowbar.

clue.text: Container holding nothing but a picture

indicators.note: the container holds the letter for nothing within it

parts.note: a carton is a container
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A box with nothing in it except an image.
explanation.definitionFit: A comic drawing or animated film is a kind of picture.

clue.text: Find a way to give the suite a face-lift

definitions.meaning: to put new fabric on a sofa and chairs

explanation.surface: Looking for ways to smarten up the sofa and armchairs.
explanation.definitionFit: To regain something lost, and split as re-cover, to put new upholstery on furniture.

clue.text: Hurries to get the whiskies

explanation.surface: Someone rushing off to fetch drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: Dashes briefly somewhere, and small tots of spirit.

clue.text: A grill sure to be served up to resistance fighters

indicators.note: food served up is prepared and presented, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A barbecue is guaranteed for the partisans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be served up' rearranges A GRILL SURE.
explanation.definitionFit: Irregular soldiers waging war against an occupying force.

clue.text: The carriage of a drama lee curer

parts.note: the stage stands for drama
a coach is a teacher or tutor

explanation.surface: The vehicle belonging to a theatre tutor.
explanation.walkthrough: A drama lecturer is a stage coach, run together into the old horse-drawn vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse-drawn passenger vehicle running between staging posts.

clue.text: Talk about a fool, not his state of mind

indicators.note: the word for talk goes about, around, the fool

parts.note: to say is to talk
a nit is a fool

explanation.surface: Discussing an idiot whose mental condition is lacking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts A NIT inside SAY; 'not his' adds the joke that the fool lacks it.
explanation.definitionFit: Soundness of mind is a mental condition.

clue.text: Insisted on ordering a dessert

indicators.note: putting in order rearranges the letters

explanation.surface: Someone firmly demanded a pudding.
explanation.definitionFit: Stated firmly is to have maintained a claim.

clue.text: After doing well a student is relaxed

indicators.note: a student comes after the phrase for doing well

parts.note: in form means performing well
L is a learner, a student driver's plate

explanation.surface: A student unwinds after succeeding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' places A L behind IN FORM.
explanation.definitionFit: Casual and unceremonious, as in relaxed dress.

clue.text: A greedy fellow gets in lots of wood

indicators.note: a piece gets into another, placed within it

parts.note: many means lots
a hog is a greedy person

explanation.surface: A glutton stocks up on plenty of timber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets in' puts A HOG inside MANY.
explanation.definitionFit: A reddish-brown tropical hardwood used for furniture.

clue.text: Vulgar journal became a little fly

parts.note: mag is the informal short word for a magazine
got as in got angry, became

explanation.surface: A trashy magazine turned into a small insect.
explanation.definitionFit: A larva is the young form of a fly.

clue.text: Tried to get right inside the cooker

indicators.note: the letter for right is put inside the cooker

parts.note: a stove is a cooker

explanation.surface: Attempted to get things right in the oven.
explanation.definitionFit: Made an effort, attempted hard.

clue.text: Mr Bevin sounded serious

indicators.note: the name is spoken and heard as a word

parts.note: Ernest Bevin was a British Labour politician and Foreign Secretary

explanation.surface: A politician's voice came across as grave.
explanation.walkthrough: Ernest Bevin was a 1940s British Foreign Secretary; his first name said out loud gives the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Sincere and solemn in intent.

clue.text: A howling success for the comedian

explanation.surface: A comic's show brings the house down.
explanation.definitionFit: A piercing cry, and informally something hugely funny.

clue.text: Plenty of variety for the right nominee

definitions.meaning: a wide range to pick from

explanation.surface: A wide field of candidates for picking the best one.
explanation.definitionFit: A wide selection, and also a wise selection of candidate.

clue.text: Disheartened pioneer becomes a mole

indicators.note: the heart of the word is removed, the middle letters spelling a number

explanation.surface: A downcast trailblazer turns into a burrowing animal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disheartened' removes ONE from the middle of PIONEER. A mole is also a stone breakwater.
explanation.definitionFit: A mole is a jetty or breakwater built out into the sea.

clue.text: Kitty may take the plunge in it

definitions.text: may take the plunge in it
definitions.meaning: a place to dive into water

explanation.surface: A cat might dive in.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot of pooled money, and a swimming bath for diving.

clue.text: How best to serve the interests of the immoderate jingoist

definitions.text: How best to serve the interests of the immoderate jingoist

parts.words: How best to serve the interests of the immoderate jingoist
parts.note: a tennis serve with the hand above shoulder, and split, arming to excess as a warmonger wishes

explanation.definitionFit: A delivery made with the hand raised above the shoulder, also read as excessive arming.

clue.text: The English aim is sentimental

parts.note: a motive is an aim or purpose

explanation.surface: The English purpose is soppy.
explanation.definitionFit: Stirring the feelings, appealing to emotion.

clue.text: Then I'll get him, I resolve, brought to public notice

indicators.note: to resolve is to break down into parts and re-form them

explanation.surface: Someone vows to catch a man and expose him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resolve' rearranges THEN ILL GET HIM I.
explanation.definitionFit: Receiving public attention, in the glare of publicity.
